locationId.description: Reference to Location. (Relationship: Location 1:N EmployeeAction). The location where the action was performed.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the WorkWise application's core features, focusing on staff management, customer directory, work scheduling, and real-time employee action tracking. The design prioritizes authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. Path-based ownership is utilized for Staff-owned data (WorkSchedules, EmployeeActions), ensuring simple and secure rules. 

To achieve Authorization Independence (DBAC) with no custom claims, roles will be stored in the database and enforced via rules based on `request.auth.uid`.

To support the required QAPs (Rules are not Filters), the structure uses segregation to avoid mixing data with different access needs in the same collections. Each top-level collection has clear security requirements. Staff-owned data is nested under the `/staff/{staffId}` path, providing implicit ownership for the data.

Denormalization: There is no apparent need to denormalize any data for Authorization Independence due to the application of Path-Based ownership, which inherently makes each document's access control depend solely on its path, and therefore, independent from other documents in the database.
